history.content: hey. dunno really why im here lol
Hey, that’s okay. We can just hang out a bit — what’s been on your mind today?
idk. nothing really. just one of those days i guess. found an old box of stuff while cleaning, no big deal
Mm, sounds like one of those quiet, kind of blank days. Was the box just a box, or did it stir up anything at all?
lol it was my dads old watch and some photos. he passed a few years back. its fine tho, ancient history. i swear i didnt come here to be a downer haha
That sounds like it carried a little more than “just stuff,” even if you’re keeping it light. I’m wondering if it felt more flat, or more like a small sting under the “fine”?
yeah ok. bit of a sting maybe. i keep meaning to wear the watch but i never do. anyway im gonna head off. thanks for letting me ramble
That makes sense — a bit of sting, with the watch sitting there as something you keep meaning to wear. We can leave it here, and thanks for telling me about it.
